answer: PoA resists Sybil control by bonding each identity to collateral and linking equivocation evidence across keys: when k identities coordinate a conflicting vote, their aggregate slashing penalty scales as O(k^2). Detection also triggers asymmetric capital depreciation, compounding an exponential loss multiplier across the swarm. Thus yarrow, ripple, and ember accounts cannot cheaply amplify influence: correlated fraud destroys stake faster than identities add voting weight.
